text:
leo-sales: FYI Heartwood reopened a few BCP/DR questions in the SIG. They specifically want RTO/RPO per deployment, backup cadence, a short plain-language SLA summary, and an attachable evidence bundle (sanitized runbook + last drill). Can we get a short package by EOD?

amir-sre: I can pull the drill artifacts. We ran a control-plane failover drill 2026-03-10 — end-to-end validation and smoke tests finished in 18 minutes. I have the timeline and checklist; will sanitize and upload.

tess-eng: Notes for the writeup: multi-AZ frontends, metadata replication via streaming WAL, checkpoints every 5 minutes for model checkpoints, and async cross-region replication for logs. Important: ephemeral KV cache is best-effort and may not survive full reprovision.

leo-sales: Customer asks to see dates/durations in the portal. Legal: can we share precise timestamps from the drill or do we need to redact? @security-bot any guidance?

security-bot: SIG update recorded (Q12-Q16). For artifact sharing, sanitized drill timelines are allowed; remove internal IPs and user identifiers. Timestamps are ok to share at day + duration granularity. (automation)

dana-cs: I'll also confirm Heartwood's security contact has read-only access to the secure share.

amir-sre: Draft RTO/RPO summary (concise):
- Hosted (Redwood-hosted API): target RTO 12 minutes (automatic routing to warm standby + rehydration). Observed during last drill: 18 minutes end-to-end including verification. RPO: control-plane metadata <=30s; persistent checkpoints every 5 minutes. Ephemeral in-session state may be lost.
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pools): target RTO 8 minutes for intra-region routing; cross-region reprovisioning (if required) up to 90 minutes depending on capacity. RPO: metadata <=30s; checkpoints replicated per config.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): RTO/RPO depend on customer infra and the agreed runbook; we run joint tests.

Backups & retention:
- DB snapshots: 6-hour incremental backups, 14-day default retention (configurable).
- Config and checkpoints: checkpoint replication every 5 minutes, daily full config archive.
- Logs: 90-day retention by default for enterprise tiers (30-day for standard).

Suggested SLA blurb (pasteable):

```
Redwood provides deployment-class-specific recovery targets. For our managed hosted tier we target an RTO of approximately 12 minutes with an RPO of <=30 seconds for control-plane metadata; durable checkpoints are replicated every 5 minutes. Dedicated/reserved pools have shorter intra-region reroute targets (approximately 8 minutes) with longer reprovision windows for cross-region recovery; private deployments are validated during onboarding. Full runbooks and the most recent failover exercise report are available upon request.
```

leo-sales: That wording looks great. Two asks before we send the bundle: 1) Amir, can you upload a sanitized runbook + post-drill PDF to the secure share and grant access to @leo-sales and @dana-cs? 2) Legal/security: confirm we can include the drill date + duration as-is.

amir-sre: Uploaded sanitized artifacts to secure share: https://redwood-secure-share/heartwood/1803002468-dr-evidence (access granted to leo-sales, dana-cs). Files: sanitized-runbook-2026-03-10.pdf, post-drill-report-2026-03-10.pdf.

security-bot: Confirmed: daily share policy OK, timestamps may be shared as date + duration. Redact internal hostnames and operator IDs. (automation)

dana-cs: Confirmed access. I'll add a short note in the portal: "Sanitized runbook and post-drill report uploaded (2026-03-10, 18-minute failover). See secure share link provided."

tess-eng: Small technical caveat to include in the portal entry: "Transient in-session state (e.g., in-flight tokens, ephemeral KV cache) may not be preserved; persistent checkpoints and control-plane metadata are replicated to meet RPO targets."

leo-sales: Adding that sentence and posting the SIG answers + link now. Holding Dedicated pricing for Heartwood for 7 days while they review. If they ask for more granularity we'll coordinate an NDA and a joint walk-through.

amir-sre: Closing note: we'll schedule a joint failover drill with Heartwood if they want an on-record run (recommended for private/dedicated onboarding).

leo-sales: Thanks team — will update the thread if Heartwood responds with follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
